name: Export FCS
description: Writes the projected cells as FCS 3.1 files, one per sample, in a ZIP. Version 1 is a Rust implementation with a transposed projection: channels on rows, cells on columns, with the sample and any annotations (UMAP, cluster, population) as column factors, stored once per cell instead of once per value. Numbers are written as they are; text is written as codes 1..k with a legend.

properties.name: file_factor
properties.description: Column factor that splits cells into files, one FCS file per value. Empty: the column factor called filename (or ending in .filename); without one, every cell goes into one file.

properties.name: datatype
properties.description: F writes 32-bit floats, as cytometers and FlowJo do; D writes 64-bit, needed for integer ids above 16,777,216.

metaFactors.name: Channels
metaFactors.description: The channel ($PnN), and optionally the marker as a second row factor ($PnS).

metaFactors.name: Cells
metaFactors.description: The cells. The file factor (filename) splits them into files; every other column factor (UMAP, cluster, population, event id) becomes a parameter of every file.

metaFactors.name: Value
metaFactors.description: The value of each channel for each cell.

outputSpecsV2.description: Export operator - outputs a ZIP of FCS files
